# Good Partner

> Never forget the little things. A private journal for dates, gifts, and quality time.

A Grok Bot may use this app when a person shares a brief from the app, or asks for help with a partner's dates and gifts.

- [Bot skill](https://goodpartner.grok.me/bot.md): how to use the journal without publishing it
- [App](https://goodpartner.grok.me/)
- [Privacy](https://goodpartner.grok.me/privacy): no account, journal stays on the device until the person shares it

Do not invent dates, sizes, or dislikes. Do not post a journal.
